title: convertCharsToStrings
summary: Convert character arrays and cellstr values to string arrays.

gpu_support.notes: No GPU kernel is needed. Non-character values, including resident integer arrays, pass through unchanged without provider access.

fusion.notes: Not eligible for fusion; this builtin materializes host text or logical results.

description: [out1, ...] = convertCharsToStrings(value1, ...) - Convert character arrays and cellstr values to string arrays.
behaviors: A character array converts to one string scalar by concatenating its columns; a cell array consisting entirely of character vectors converts to a same-size string array.
Variadic inputs convert independently to corresponding variadic outputs.
Every other datatype is returned identically, including exact integer storage and resident provider ownership.
examples: convertCharsToStrings(char matrix) returns one string scalar formed by concatenating the matrix columns.
